Create Single Stacked Plot (Internal)

Source: R/plot.R
dot-create_single_stacked_plot.Rd

Create a single stacked plot from GTAP data for internal use.

Usage

.create_single_stacked_plot(
  data,
  total_data,
  x_axis_from,
  stack_value_from,
  plot_title,
  unit,
  panel_rows,
  panel_cols,
  panel_var = "Experiment",
  show_total = TRUE,
  invert_pane = FALSE,
  top_impact = NULL,
  plot_style_config = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing plotting data.

total_data

A data frame with total values.

x_axis_from

Character. Column used for x-axis categories.

stack_value_from

Character. Column for stack components.

plot_title

Character. Title of the plot.

unit

Character. Unit of measurement.

panel_rows

Numeric. Number of rows in panel layout.

panel_cols

Numeric. Number of columns in panel layout.

panel_var

Character. Column for panel facets. Default is "Experiment".

show_total

Logical. Whether to display total values. Default is TRUE.

invert_pane

Logical. Whether to flip plot orientation. Default is FALSE.

top_impact

Numeric. Number of top impacts to display. Default is NULL.

plot_style_config

List. Custom plot styling configuration.

Value

A ggplot2 object representing the stacked plot.

See also

stack_plot
